proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ A B hA hB
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.indepSet_iff_measure_inter_eq_mul hA hB μ]
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.real]
    rw [h, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  · intro h
    simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.real] at h
    rw [← ENNReal.toReal_mul] at h
    exact (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _) (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _))).mp h
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A B : Set Ω), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → (ProbabilityTheory.IndepSet A B μ ↔ μ.real (A ∩ B) = μ.real A * μ.real B)
